title: A B C of Gothic Architecture
sourceTitle: A B C of Gothic Architecture
author: John Henry Parker
description: "A B C of Gothic Architecture" by John Henry Parker is an architectural guide examining the evolution of Gothic architecture, likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work serves as an introduction aimed at beginners, presenting key styles and characteristics of Gothic architecture through the lens of historical examples.

authorInfo.bio: John Henry Parker (1806–1884) wrote A B C of Gothic Architecture. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
